contexts.text: To be burnt, and fire, are predicated of cupidities.
Under Fire, see these references. AC 7861. AC 9141:2. AC 10038. AC 10115. AC 10463. AE 1126.
To burn the city () = to destroy and vastate those who are in doctrinal things of falsity.
Under Bring forth, see this reference.
The third part of the trees burnt up () = the Knowledges of truth destroyed by the evil of cupidities. AR 400. AE 506.
To kindle, and to burn, = to lay waste through the cupidities of the loves of self and of the world.
You would have burnt your fingers...
To burn her with fire () = to execrate that religiosity as profane, and destroy it in themselves... The reason being that the penalty of the profanation of what was holy was burning. Illustrated.
When they see the smoke of her burning () = when they see these turned into profane things.
The roll that was burnt () = the Word, which is said to be burnt when falsified and adulterated, which is effected through the concupiscence of falsity from evil.
The burning of the whole earth () = the devastation of the Church through self-love.
By the earth, and the world, and the inhabitants in it, which shall be burnt () is signified that the Church will perish as to all its truths and goods through infernal love.
Burning () = the condemnation and punishment of the evils which gush forth from these loves.
